# Designer Instructions

- Tokens are the source of truth. No magic numbers in component styles or stories.
- Use semantic token names and token-driven theming.
- Keep component APIs small, explicit, and composable.
- Every meaningful component change requires Storybook story updates.
- Follow `.claude/conventions/accessibility-style.md` for focus, contrast, keyboard, and labelling rules.
- Read `.claude/conventions/designer-style.md` for the complete style guide.
